text:
Dark mode is here, and your eyes are going to thank you! 🌙✨

After listening to you, our amazing community, we're thrilled to announce that dark mode is now live for 100% of users, rolled out on May 12! Nearly 40% of our beta testers asked for it, and we heard you loud and clear.

We didn't just flip the colors. We sweated the details to make every word easy to read, with a contrast ratio of 7:1, which exceeds the WCAG AAA standard for body text. Your notes glow with clarity, whether you're writing at midnight or drafting in a sunlit café.

Here's what you can look forward to:

🌑 **Easy on the eyes**: Reduced glare for late-night brainstorming sessions
🎨 **Crisp, clean text**: High contrast that keeps every word sharp
⚡ **Seamless switching**: Toggle between light and dark in a single tap

Head to Settings, choose your vibe, and let your ideas shine in the dark! 💡

Thank you for helping us build something truly special. Keep creating, keep dreaming, and keep those brilliant notes coming!
